ValidationRule.description: Assigned Portfolio/BU and Assigned Tribe/BU-1 fields must be completed before the record can be saved/ closed if PSI Ranking is either 1,2 or 3.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Systemic_Issue', ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), OR( ISNULL(SI_Assigned_to_Portfolios__c), ISNULL(SI_Relevant_Tribes__c) ), OR( ISPICKVAL(SI_PSI_Ranking__c, "1"), ISPICKVAL(SI_PSI_Ranking__c, "2"), ISPICKVAL(SI_PSI_Ranking__c, "3") )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Assigned Portfolio/BU and Assigned Tribe/BU-1 fields are required.
